instruction: Photographic full shot of a ballet studio with wooden barres. Three young dancers stand in a line: on the left, the red-haired girl in a pink leotard and skirt (R3) looks down; in the center, the girl with slicked-back hair in a pink leotard and skirt (R2) extends her left arm and looks left; on the right, the light-brown-haired girl in a pink leotard and skirt (R1) stands facing forward. They wear white tights and ballet slippers on a reflective grey floor. Bright, cool studio lighting illuminates the clean white wall behind them.
